panels.description: Top 10 characters by leaderboard lookups in the last 30d. Needs Prometheus retention of at least 30d.

targets.expr: (sum by (character) (increase(seeleland_character_lookups_total[$__interval])) and on (character) topk(5, sum by (character) (increase(seeleland_character_lookups_total[$__range])))) * on (character) group_left (name) max by (character, name) (seeleland_character_info)
